messages:
lucy_prod: Quick sync — PRD draft for Reserved Pools (sizing / SLOs / autoscale) is up: https://go/repo/prd-reserved-pools. Need concrete SLO targets, hysteresis rules, and edge-case list for launch criteria. Can folks give feedback by EOD Fri? ping @mira_eng @sam_sre @devon_se

mira_eng: skimmed it. suggestion: baseline latency SLOs: p50 <= 20ms, p95 <= 60ms, p99 <= 120ms for 512-token gen. throughput per-GPU sustained target ~400 tokens/s for typical Llama2-13B quantized path — depends on batch sizes.

sam_sre: we should split availability vs latency SLAs. propose availability 99.95% for Dedicated Reserved Pools (enterprise tier). Warm-pool requirement: be able to absorb 3x baseline burst for 30s without dropping requests. Hysteresis: scale down only after 10m of <target load; scale up on 2x sustained for 60s.

alex_pm: customers care more about tail than avg. is p99=120ms realistic without huge cost uplift? want a cost vs slippage table in the PRD.

devon_se: for Customer A we need per-tenant throughput guarantees. That implies either strict isolation (dedicated slices) or per-tenant soft limits + throttles and guaranteed fallback to hosted models. recommend per-tenant tokens/s caps + auto-throttle policy.

jen_sales: FYI — early-access customer asked for SLA language by Monday. if we can't promise p99.9 we need explicit degradation policy they can sign off on.

mira_eng: list of edge cases to add: cold-start for new model versions, KV-cache invalidation during rollouts, quantized variant fallbacks, cross-tenant noisy neighbors. acceptance criterion: during a canary rollout no more than 3x latency spike for 95% of requests; circuit-breaker behavior documented.

sam_sre: runbook item: add autoscale thrash protection — circuit breaker after 3 scale events within 5m, force cooldown 15m and reroute to lower-quality variant if necessary :warning:. also add alert thresholds for warm-pool depletion and cache miss storms.

lucy_prod: Draft acceptance criteria (working):
- SLO matrix defined: p50/p95/p99 for 128 / 512 / 2048 token profiles (response-complete latency)
- Availability SLO: 99.95% (enterprise), 99.9% (standard)
- Autoscale behavior: scale up on sustained >=2x baseline for 60s; scale down after 10m of sustained <baseline; warm pool reserve enough for 3x short burst
- Hysteresis: min instance lifetime 10m; cooldown 15m after thrash circuit trips
- Fallbacks: model-variant downgrade + region failover; documented error codes and client-friendly degradation responses
- Per-tenant quotas: tokens/s caps and billing metric mapping
If these sound ok I'll fold into PRD and add perf testing checklist.

devon_se: :thumbsup: SE side ok. please add an explicit mapping from tokens/s to billing usage so customers can predict spend when throttled. also include example config snippet for per-tenant caps.

alex_pm: quick technical question: for streaming responses, do we measure p99 at token emission or at response-complete? needs to be explicit.

mira_eng: measure latency at response-complete for customer-facing SLA. token-level metrics are useful for internal perf debugging only.

lucy_prod: great — I'll update PRD with those bullets and perf test plan. tagging @deploy-bot for staging deploy plan placeholder.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prd/reserved-pools/feature/hysteresis -> staging at 2024-11-02T09:00Z :rocket:
